title: V01-C06 Variables and State Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A complete state table showing every relevant binding before and after each assignment, including operation, previous value, new value, and invariant status.
A binding decision table that justifies const or mutable state from actual transition needs and identifies reassignment versus object mutation.

accessibility_requirements: Every state diagram has an ordered text alternative.
State tables use descriptive headers and do not rely on color.
Animations have static and reduced-motion alternatives.
Turkish technical terms include English at first meaningful use.
Code has Turkish comments and explicit expected output.
Learner instructions have measurable deliverables and time boxes.
known_risks: Learners may use the box analogy as a literal memory model.
Assignment may be confused with mathematical equality.
const may be mistaken for deep immutability.
var, let, and const differences may overload the state-learning goal.
Scope and closure detail may leak from V01-C15.
AI may remove or add mutation without preserving behavior.
Student pilot is deferred by Repository Owner until later production.
